_comment: Sampled from photographs of the author's own discs (ref/): Sony Color Collection 74 in blue and red, and a grey 60. Values are the dominant colours after quantising the plastic in each photo, so they are the discs under daylight, not catalogue colours. Blue is the primary, red the accent.

colors.name: Collection Blue
colors.role: primary: the blue disc's plastic in full light

colors.name: Night Blue
colors.role: ground, darkest blue through the shell

colors.name: Collection Red
colors.role: accent: the red disc's plastic in full light

colors.name: Shell Black
colors.role: ink: the blue-black of the shell rim and hub

colors.name: Label Silver
colors.role: light neutral: label stock, shutter metal
